g.text: reach: every namespace in the cluster
The same three edge classes as the gateway, and the same ClusterRole/Role split
ClusterRoleBinding applies in every namespace, so anything that must be namespace-limited (the Lease) ships
as a separate namespaced Role. The ClusterRole is generated from the reconcilers' RBAC markers and copied into
the chart, so the figure describes what the chart grants.
The red Secrets box is the one to audit.
The operator's standing Secret read reaches every namespace. It
writes nothing and copies nothing, but a compromised operator reads every provider key in kaalm-system and every
channel credential in every user namespace. Escalation prevention is satisfied without escalate or bind because
the minted per-channel and per-task Roles never grant more than that standing read.
